nodes.name: List Scheduled Events (next 10 days)
nodes.notes: Calendly caps this at 100 results per page; pagination is not implemented since a 10-day window for one event type is expected to stay well under that. Re-run with a narrower window / check manually if this ever needs to scale up.

nodes.name: Extract CD Bookings
nodes.notes: Same name-match heuristic as the live Calendly ingest workflow ("Darwin CD Ingest (Calendly)") -- keep them in sync if the heuristic ever changes.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO calendar_research_sessions
  (session_type, source, external_id, organizer_name, organizer_email, title, description, starts_at, ends_at, raw_payload, updated_at)
VALUES
  ('continuous_discovery', 'calendly_backfill', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (session_type, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
  organizer_name = EXCLUDED.organizer_name,
  organizer_email = EXCLUDED.organizer_email,
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  starts_at = EXCLUDED.starts_at,
  ends_at = EXCLUDED.ends_at,
  raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
  updated_at = now();

nodes.name: Upsert Backfilled CD Sessions
nodes.notes: source='calendly_backfill' so these are distinguishable from live-webhook rows. On conflict, source is intentionally NOT overwritten -- if a live webhook already captured one of these (e.g. today's earlier test bookings), it keeps its original 'calendly_webhook' provenance.
